The contractor shall be deemed to have satisfied himself with the site conditions and equi pment before bidding.

27. The payment for the AMC charges will be made on quarterly basis on submission of t he bill duly supported by user certificate to the effect that all machines have been service d and are working in good condition. 28. No advance payment will be made any circumstances. TDS will be made as per rule. The maintenance charges, quoted by the agency are on yearly basis and inclusive of alltax es and levies as per various laws/ regulation/ Act. (s) applicable. 29. OEM authorized dealer have to submit valid certificate for participation of this bid . 31. Site Inspection-The bidder is advised to inspect the site and all RO/UV Water Purifiers and Water Coolers before submission of the bid. Submission of the bid shall be deemed to confirm that the bidder has fully examined the site, equipment, scope of work, quantities, specifications, spare requirements a nd all terms & conditions of the NIT. No claim for additional payment, compensation, rate revision or e xtension of time arising out of failure to inspect the site or understand the scope of work shall be enter tained after submission of the bid. 32. Scope Includes All Necessary Repairs-The contractor shall repair and/or replace, at its own cost, any spare part, component, consumable or accessory required to keep the equipment fully functional, whether specifically mentioned in the tender document or not. No additional payment shall be admissi ble for any such repair, replacement, labour, transportation or incidental work. 33. No Extra Claim-Non-mention of any spare part, component, consumable or repair acti vity in the tender document shall not relieve the contractor of its responsibility. No extra clai m shall be entertained on this account. 34. Correct Capacity & Technical Specification-All replacement components including RO mem branes, pumps, UV lamps, compressors, motors, SMPS, filters and other parts shall be of the appropri ate capacity, rating and technical specification recommended for the respective equipment. Installatio n of lower-capacity or technically inferior components shall not be permitted. 35. No Removal of Parts from Other Machines-The contractor shall not remove any functional o r usable spare part or component from one equipment for installation in another equipment. Each RO/ Water Cooler shall be maintained as an independent functional unit unless specifically permitted in wr iting by the Engineer-in-Charge. 36. Availability of Spare Parts-Non-availability of spare parts in the local market shall no t be accepted as a reason for delay in repair. The contractor shall arrange all required materi als at its own cost from appropriate sources. 37. Preventive Maintenance-Preventive maintenance of all equipment shall be carried out periodi cally as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge, including cleaning, inspection, testing and servicing. Prev entive maintenance records shall be maintained in the logbook.

38. Complaint Response Time-The contractor shall attend every complaint within 04 hours of repo rting and restore the equipment to satisfactory working condition within 24 hours. In exceptional cases requiring major repairs, prior written approval of the Engineer-in-Charge shall be obtained. 39. Repeat Breakdown: Repeated breakdown of the same equipment due to poor workmans hip, use of inferior materials, or improper repair shall be treated as unsatisfactory performance. The contractor shall rectify such defects and restore the equipment to satisfactory working condition at hi s own cost without any additional payment. In case the contractor fails to attend and rectify the defe cts within the stipulated time, the department may get the work executed through another agency a t the risk and cost of the contractor. Any additional expenditure incurred by the department for s uch work shall be recovered from the contractor. Continued unsatisfactory performance may also res ult in withholding of payment, forfeiture of Performance Guarantee/Security, and/or termination of th e contract as per the applicable contract condition 40. Replacement of Defective Parts-All replaced defective spare parts/components shall be produced before the Engineer-in-Charge or authorized representative for verification befor e disposal, if required. 41. Minimum Stock of Critical Spares-The contractor shall maintain adequate stock of frequently required spare parts and consumables to ensure uninterrupted maintenance services. 42. Responsibility for All Makes-The successful bidder shall be responsible for maintenance of all makes, models and capacities of RO/UV Water Purifiers and Water Coolers covered under the contract, irrespective of the OEM/brand with which the bidder is associated. 43. Skilled Technical Personnel-The contractor shall deploy trained and experienced ser vice personnel having adequate knowledge of maintenance of multi-brand RO/UV Water Purif iers and Water Coolers. The Engineer-in-Charge may require replacement of any personnel found technically unsuitable. 44. Service Contact Details-The contractor shall provide the contact details of the service engineer and escalation matrix. Any change in deployed personnel shall be intimated to the Engineer-in-Charge. 45. Joint Initial Inspection-At the commencement of the contract, a joint inspection of all equipment shall be carried out. A machine-wise inventory indicating make, model, capacity, l ocation and existing condition shall be jointly prepared and signed. 46. Addition/Deletion of Equipment-AIIMS reserves the right to add or delete equipment during the contract period. Payment or deduction shall be made on a pro-rata basis at the ac cepted rates. 47. Contractor's Overall Responsibility-The accepted CAMC rates shall be deemed to in clude all labour, supervision, transportation, tools & plants, testing, servicing, repair, replace ment of spare parts, consumables and all incidental expenses required for maintaining the eq uipment in continuous, safe and satisfactory working condition throughout the contract perio d. 48. Approval Does Not Transfer Responsibility-Approval of any spare part or repair by the Engineer-in-Charge shall not relieve the contractor of responsibility regarding quality, co mpatibility, performance or satisfactory functioning of the equipment.

49. The successful bidder has to execute an agreement with APL in a non-judicial stamp p aper of denomination not less than Rs. 100.00 within 10 days after issue of LOI / WorkOrder .
